main.audit_boundary: Actual-path NumPy gradient/Adam checks, independent losses, raw laws, identities, transforms, graph hierarchy, GMM likelihood and denominators. Failed endpoints retain partial evidence and are not claimed as verified fits.

preflight.audit_boundary: Actual-path NumPy gradient/Adam checks, independent losses, raw laws, identities, transforms, graph hierarchy, GMM likelihood and denominators. Failed endpoints retain partial evidence and are not claimed as verified fits.

calibration_scope: Approximate fitted joint raw-Gaussian departure test with full neural/PCA refits; not species/selected-K significance
interpretation: Ten independent datasets per law: initial pilot with wide uncertainty, not general size/power validation
